info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Tugtupit Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Tugtupit Recliner Detail Creation API allows businesses to add detailed information about the Tugtupit recliner to their product catalog. This API facilitates the submission of specifications, images, and pricing information, which are essential for enhancing the visibility of the product to potential customers. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and retailers looking to maintain or enrich their product offerings. By using this API, businesses can streamline the addition of new products and ensure that their catalogs are up-to-date and informative.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information for the Tugtupit Recliner model. Use this operation to submit essential details such as specifications, features, and other relevant information to enhance the product listing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the details required to create or update a Tugtupit recliner. Ensure the payload adheres to the specified schema to avoid validation errors.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the response contains the requested data.
